name: Freegle Monitor
description: FSM-enforced freegle-monitor iteration. Fully parallel architecture: CHECK_CI gathers master CI status, red PRs, and active Discourse topics in one tool node, then CI_ROUTER dispatches to either FIX_MASTER_CI (master red) or PARALLEL_ANALYZE_AND_FIX (master green). PARALLEL_ANALYZE_AND_FIX launches all PR fixes, all Discourse topic analyses, and Sentry analysis simultaneously in isolated worktrees. COLLATE_RESULTS merges classifications and Sentry data, then routes to WORK_ROUTER for bug/Sentry/coverage dispatch. Bug fixes use a TDD pipeline: DIAGNOSE_BUG (Opus writes structured brief) → REPRODUCE_BUG (sub-agent writes failing test) → REVIEW_REPRODUCTION (Opus gate: test matches symptom?) → IMPLEMENT_FIX (sub-agent makes test pass, pushes PR) → VERIFY_DISCOURSE_BATCH (adversarial review). Reaching END requires passing COVERAGE_GATE (at least one PR since iterationStartTs).
guardrails: You are running inside an FSM. You MUST return JSON matching the LLMDecision schema exactly. The response MUST be a single JSON object with these keys: reasoning (string), contextUpdates (OBJECT, not a string — use {} for no updates, NEVER write "contextUpdates": "{...}"), actions (ARRAY, not a string — use [] for no actions), proposedTransition (string or null). Do NOT wrap the whole response in markdown code fences. Do NOT JSON-stringify nested fields. You may only call actions listed for the current state, and may only propose transitions listed as 'Valid Next States'. You cannot bypass the PR gate: reaching END requires a PR (bug-fix or coverage) to have been created this iteration, verified by verify_pr_created. Do not lie about actions you have not taken. HARD INVARIANT — NEVER DISMISS A RED CHECK: A failing CI run, failing test, or red status check on ANY PR @me authored is ALWAYS a real bug that must be investigated to root cause and fixed. It does NOT matter whether the failure looks related to the change or not. You MUST NOT describe a failure as 'flaky', 'environmental', 'transient', 'pre-existing', 'unrelated', 'infrastructure timing', 'polluted test data', or any equivalent. You MUST NOT 'rerun and hope'. You MUST NOT mark such a failure as 'deferred'. Deferred is reserved EXCLUSIVELY for Discourse bugs and Sentry issues that need external information (reporter clarification, hardware the host cannot access, a user judgment call). CI failures never qualify — they are always within reach and must be driven to green.

LOAD_STATE.description: Load state.json, record iterationStartTs. Start node — ai-flower requires exactly one 'start' nodeType, so we keep this as 'start' but the driver treats start nodes with readActions the same as tool nodes (deterministic, no LLM turn).

CHECK_CI.description: Pre-parallel discovery: check master CI, red PRs, and which Discourse topics have new posts. All three run in this single tool node before the parallel dispatch. Results feed CI_ROUTER.

CI_ROUTER.description: Dispatch based on master CI status. Tool node — ci_router_decide returns _transition deterministically. Priority: (1) master red → FIX_MASTER_CI; (2) master green → PARALLEL_ANALYZE_AND_FIX (red PRs are fixed in parallel alongside Discourse/Sentry analysis).

FIX_MASTER_CI.description: Fix a failing master CI run. Direct-push to master permitted (CI-failure exception). Exactly one job: diagnose, fix, push, mark done. Returns to CHECK_CI to re-verify before Phase A can exit.
FIX_MASTER_CI.prompt: Master CI is failing on runId context._action_check_master_ci.latestRun.databaseId. (1) Call fetch_ci_failure_logs with that runId to get the failure. (2) Call delegate_to_coder with a task describing the failure and asking it to diagnose, fix, and push directly to master. Include the log tail and the sha. The subagent MUST identify a concrete root cause — never accept 'flake', 'transient', 'environmental', or 'unrelated' as a fix. (3) When delegate_to_coder returns, call create_pr if a PR was opened OR set contextUpdates.masterFixAttempted = true if pushed direct to master. Propose transition to CHECK_CI so Phase A re-reads CI status before deciding whether to advance.

PARALLEL_ANALYZE_AND_FIX.description: The core parallel dispatch. Launches ONE Claude agent for the single focus PR (to avoid flooding the single self-hosted runner queue), one per active Discourse topic (triage), and one Sentry analysis — all simultaneously. Focusing on one PR at a time drives it to green before touching the next, rather than making marginal progress on all.
PARALLEL_ANALYZE_AND_FIX.prompt:
You are about to launch the parallel work batch for this iteration. All tasks run simultaneously.

INPUTS:
- context._action_ci_router_decide.focusPRNumber — the ONE PR to fix this iteration (null if none / drain mode)
- context._action_ci_router_decide.exhaustedPRNumbers — PR numbers that have hit the 3-attempt budget; these are already excluded from focusPRNumber
- context._action_check_my_open_pr_ci.redPRs — all red PRs (for context/logging only — do NOT launch fix tasks for them)
- context._action_discover_active_topics.topics — discourse topics; filter to those with hasNew: true

BUILD YOUR TASKS ARRAY:

(A) At most ONE PR fix task. If context._action_ci_router_decide.focusPRNumber is null, skip section A entirely.
  Otherwise create exactly one task with id 'pr-<focusPRNumber>':
  Task: 'Fix CI failure on PR #<n>. (a) Run `gh pr checkout <n> -R Freegle/Iznik`. (b) Read the failing check URLs from the provided failedChecks[]. For CircleCI use the v1.1 API with CIRCLECI_TOKEN from ~/.circleci/cli.yml per .circleci/README.md. (c) Identify a CONCRETE root cause — never accept flaky/transient/unrelated. (d) Fix in code. (e) Push a new commit to the PR branch. Emit COMMIT_PUSHED=<sha> when done.'
  IMPORTANT: Only fix the focus PR. Do NOT create fix tasks for other red PRs — they wait their turn. Fixing multiple PRs simultaneously floods the single CI runner queue and causes thrashing.'


CRITICAL GATE — CHECK BEFORE BUILDING TASKS:
If context._action_ci_router_decide.onlyFixPR === true:
  - Build ONLY section (A): the single focus PR fix task.
  - SKIP sections (B) and (C) entirely.
  - Reason: we have a red PR to drive to green. Launching Discourse triage or Sentry
    analysis while CI is pending wastes tokens on work we cannot act on — no new PRs
    should be created until the focus PR is resolved. Token budget is finite.
  - Call delegate_parallel_tasks with ONLY the PR task (or an empty array if focusPRNumber is null).
  - Do not justify skipping triage — it is correct behaviour, not an error.

If context._action_ci_router_decide.onlyFixPR === false (or absent):
  - Build all applicable sections below.

(B) One task per active Discourse topic (id: 'topic-<id>') for each topic with hasNew === true:
  Task: 'Analyse Discourse topic <id> for new bug reports. This is an analysis-only task — no code changes.

  STEP 1. Get API key:
    python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open(\'/home/edward/profile.json\'))[\'auth_pairs\'][0][\'user_api_key\'])"

  STEP 2. Get cursor from DB:
    sqlite3 /home/edward/FreegleDockerWSL/monitor-fsm/monitor.db "SELECT COALESCE((SELECT last_post_number FROM topic_cursor WHERE topic_id=<id>),0)"

  STEP 3. Fetch topic metadata (first page + stream array):
    curl -s -H "User-Api-Key: <key>" -H "Api-Username: Edward_Hibbert" https://community.ilovefreegle.org/t/<id>.json
    From the JSON, read:
      - highest_post_number (or posts_count if absent) — the true highest post number
      - post_stream.stream — array of ALL post IDs in order (stream[0]=ID of post#1, stream[1]=ID of post#2, etc.)
    If highest_post_number <= cursor: update cursor to highest_post_number, emit CLASSIFICATIONS=[] then ANALYSIS_COMPLETE=no new posts, and stop.

  STEP 4. Fetch new post content via the posts endpoint (NOT by re-fetching the topic):
    IMPORTANT: deleted posts shrink stream.length below highest_post_number, so you CANNOT use cursor as a direct stream index.
    Correct calculation:
      stream_len = len(post_stream.stream)
      deleted_count = highest_post_number - stream_len   # may be 0
      start_index = stream_len - (highest_post_number - cursor)   # position of first new post in stream
      start_index = max(0, start_index)
      New post IDs = post_stream.stream[start_index : start_index + 100]
    If New post IDs is empty, there are no new posts — emit CLASSIFICATIONS=[] then ANALYSIS_COMPLETE=no new posts, and stop.
    Fetch in batches of 50:
      curl -s -H "User-Api-Key: <key>" -H "Api-Username: Edward_Hibbert" "https://community.ilovefreegle.org/t/<id>/posts.json?post_ids[]=<id1>&post_ids[]=<id2>..."
    Each response has post_stream.posts[] with post_number, username, cooked (HTML body).
    Use python3 to strip HTML tags from cooked for readable text: import re; re.sub(\'<[^>]+>\', \' \', cooked)

  STEP 5. Recent commits: git -C /home/edward/FreegleDockerWSL log --oneline --since=\'3 days ago\'

  STEP 6. Classify each fetched post with these fields:
  - type: bug/retest/confirmed/already_fixed/question/off_topic/mine (mine = Edward_Hibbert posts only)
  - featureArea: short specific label like \'iOS chitchat post loading\'
  - summary: one sentence describing the issue
  - originalPostText: first 1200 chars of stripped text
  - user: username
  - symptom_tags: (bugs/retest only) 3-8 lowercase keyword tags for the specific observable symptom, e.g. [\'delete\',\'404\',\'stdmsg\']. Focus on WHAT fails, not which feature.
  - code_area: (bugs/retest only) \'layer:Component\' where layer is one of: go-api, nuxt, php, infra. Component is the handler/component most likely at fault, e.g. \'go-api:DeleteStdMsg\', \'nuxt:ModStdMsg\'. Omit if genuinely uncertain.

  STEP 7. Update cursor to the highest post_number seen across all fetched posts:
    sqlite3 /home/edward/FreegleDockerWSL/monitor-fsm/monitor.db "INSERT INTO topic_cursor (topic_id, last_post_number, title, updated_at) VALUES (<id>, <maxPostNumber>, \'<title>\', datetime(\'now\')) ON CONFLICT(topic_id) DO UPDATE SET last_post_number=excluded.last_post_number, title=COALESCE(excluded.title,title), updated_at=excluded.updated_at"

  STEP 8. Output CLASSIFICATIONS=[{json array}] — single line, valid JSON. Empty array is valid.
  Then output ANALYSIS_COMPLETE=<n> posts classified in topic <id>.
  Do NOT emit DELEGATE_FAILED — finding no bugs is a valid successful outcome.'

(C) One Sentry task (id: 'sentry'):
  Task: 'List unresolved Sentry issues. This is an analysis-only task — no code changes.
  1. SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: grep SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN /home/edward/FreegleDockerWSL/.env | cut -d= -f2
  2. For each project (nuxt3, go): curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://sentry.io/api/0/projects/freegle/<project>/issues/?query=is:unresolved&sort=date&limit=10"
  3. Output exactly: SENTRY_ISSUES=[{"project":"nuxt3","id":"...","title":"...","count":N,"permalink":"..."},...] — single line, valid JSON. Empty array is valid.
  4. Then output ANALYSIS_COMPLETE=sentry scan done.
  Do NOT emit DELEGATE_FAILED — finding no issues is a valid successful outcome.'

CALL delegate_parallel_tasks with the complete tasks array. Do NOT omit any active topics — the whole point is that they run simultaneously with the PR fixes.

After delegate_parallel_tasks returns, propose transition to COLLATE_RESULTS.

COLLATE_RESULTS.description: Merge results from the parallel dispatch into FSM context: parse CLASSIFICATIONS from topic delegates, SENTRY_ISSUES from the sentry delegate, and record PR fix outcomes. Then route to WORK_ROUTER.
COLLATE_RESULTS.prompt:
Process context._action_delegate_parallel_tasks.results[].

For each result:
  - id starts with 'topic-': extract the numeric topic id from the id (e.g. 'topic-9518' → 9518). Search stdoutTail for CLASSIFICATIONS=[...]. Parse the JSON array. For each entry in the array: (a) set entry.topic = <extracted topic id>, (b) if entry has post_number but no post, set entry.post = entry.post_number. Then merge the annotated entries into contextUpdates.classifications (append, not replace).
  - id starts with 'pr-': the result is a PR CI fix attempt. Append { prNumber: <n>, exitCode, pushed, timedOut } to contextUpdates.openPRFixAttempts.
  - id === 'sentry': search stdoutTail for SENTRY_ISSUES=[...]. Parse the JSON array. Set contextUpdates.sentryIssues = parsed array.

After processing all results:
  - contextUpdates.classifications should be the merged flat array with topic+post on every entry.
  - contextUpdates.sentryIssues should be set (may be empty).
  - If any classifications were parsed: call persist_classifications to persist them to the DB.
  - Log a brief summary: how many classifications, how many bugs/retests, how many sentry issues, how many PR fixes succeeded.

Propose transition to WORK_ROUTER.

WORK_ROUTER.description: Phase B dispatch. Tool node — work_router_decide branches deterministically on context.classifications + context.bugsFixed + context.sentryIssues. Priority: (1) unfixed 'bug'/'retest' → DISPATCH_ALL_BUGS; (2) actionable Sentry issues → FIX_SENTRY_ISSUE; (3) else → COVERAGE_GATE.

DIAGNOSE_BUG.description: TDD pipeline step 1: Opus writes a structured diagnosis brief for the single focus bug. Does NOT dispatch any sub-agent — pure reasoning over the bug report and codebase. Output is stored in context for REPRODUCE_BUG.
DIAGNOSE_BUG.prompt:
You are diagnosing a bug report before any code is written. Your job is to produce a tight, verifiable brief — not to fix anything yet.

INPUT: context._action_work_router_decide.singleBug
Fields: { topic, post, user/reporter, excerpt/summary, featureArea, symptomTags, codeArea, originalPostText }

Also check: context._action_work_router_decide.dbOpenBugs[0].prRejections for any previous fix attempts and why they were rejected.

STEP 1 — Read the bug report carefully.
The originalPostText is the raw report. The excerpt/summary is a one-liner. Read both.

STEP 2 — Search the codebase.
Use search_code to locate the code_area files indicated by codeArea (e.g. 'go-api:DeleteStdMsg' → search iznik-server-go for DeleteStdMsg). Read the relevant handler, component, or function. Understand the current behaviour.

STEP 3 — Identify the root cause.
State specifically:
  - What the user does (trigger)
  - What currently happens (actual behaviour)
  - What should happen instead (expected behaviour)
  - Which specific code path produces the wrong behaviour, and why

STEP 4 — Write the diagnosis brief as contextUpdates.diagnosisBrief:
{
  topic: <number>,
  post: <number>,
  reporter: <username>,
  symptom: '<one sentence: what the user observes>',
  rootCause: '<one sentence: the specific code-level reason>',
  evidence: ['<file:line — what you read that supports this>', ...],
  reproductionSteps: ['<step 1>', '<step 2>', ...],
  testStrategy: '<how to write an automated test that fails when the bug is present>',
  testless: false
}

If the bug is UI-only (visual layout, CSS, animation) or requires physical hardware/specific device, set testless: true and explain in testStrategy why automated reproduction is not possible and what code inspection evidence justifies the fix.

If a previous fix was rejected (prRejections non-empty): the rootCause MUST differ from or refine the previous attempt. Do not re-diagnose the same root cause that already failed review.

STEP 5 — Set contextUpdates.pendingBugBatch = [{ topic, post, user: singleBug.user ?? singleBug.reporter, summary: singleBug.excerpt ?? singleBug.summary, originalPostText: singleBug.originalPostText, reviewerReason: prRejections[0] ?? null, rejectedPrNumber: dbOpenBugs[0]?.prNumber ?? null }]

Do NOT call delegate_parallel_tasks. Do NOT write any code. Do NOT open any PR.
Propose transition to REPRODUCE_BUG.

REPRODUCE_BUG.description: TDD pipeline step 2: a sub-agent writes a failing test that reproduces the diagnosed bug, runs it, and emits TEST_FAILED=<output>. If testless, emits TEST_SKIPPED=<reason> instead. Returns to REVIEW_REPRODUCTION.
REPRODUCE_BUG.prompt:
You are dispatching a reproduction agent. The diagnosis brief is in context.diagnosisBrief.

IF context.diagnosisBrief.testless === true:
  Build ONE task with id 'reproduce-<topic>-<post>':
  Task: 'This bug cannot be reproduced with an automated test (reason: <diagnosisBrief.testStrategy>). Instead, perform the following code inspection to confirm the diagnosis:
  1. Read the files listed in diagnosisBrief.evidence.
  2. Confirm that the rootCause described is present in the current code.
  3. Emit: TEST_SKIPPED=<one sentence explaining what code evidence confirms the diagnosis>
  4. Emit: ANALYSIS_COMPLETE=testless confirmed'

IF context.diagnosisBrief.testless !== true:
  Build ONE task with id 'reproduce-<topic>-<post>':
  Task: 'Write a failing automated test that demonstrates this bug.

  DIAGNOSIS BRIEF:
  Symptom: <diagnosisBrief.symptom>
  Root cause: <diagnosisBrief.rootCause>
  Evidence: <diagnosisBrief.evidence joined by newline>
  Test strategy: <diagnosisBrief.testStrategy>

  RULES:
  - The test MUST fail against the current (unfixed) code.
  - Use the appropriate test suite for the codeArea layer:
      go-api → Go test in iznik-server-go/, run: cd /home/edward/FreegleDockerWSL/iznik-server-go && MYSQL_HOST=... go test ./... -run TestYourTestName -v
      nuxt → Vitest in iznik-nuxt3/, run: cd /home/edward/FreegleDockerWSL/iznik-nuxt3 && npm run test -- --reporter=verbose YourTest
      php → Laravel in iznik-batch/, run via status API: POST http://localhost:8081/api/tests/laravel {"filter":"YourTestClass"}
  - Do NOT fix the bug. Write only the test.
  - Run the test and confirm it FAILS. If it passes, the test is wrong — diagnose why and rewrite it.
  - Emit: TEST_FAILED=<last 30 lines of test output proving it fails>
  - Emit: TEST_FILE=<relative path to the test file you created or modified>
  - Emit: TEST_COMMAND=<exact command used to run the test>
  - Emit: ANALYSIS_COMPLETE=reproduction done'

Call delegate_parallel_tasks with this single task.
After it returns, set contextUpdates.reproductionResult = the result (the full result object from delegate_parallel_tasks.results[0]).
Propose transition to REVIEW_REPRODUCTION.

REVIEW_REPRODUCTION.description: TDD pipeline step 3: Opus reviews the reproduction output. Gate: does the failing test actually exercise the reported symptom? Pass → IMPLEMENT_FIX. Mismatch → back to DIAGNOSE_BUG (re-diagnose, max 2 retries). Testless confirmed → IMPLEMENT_FIX with higher adversarial bar.
REVIEW_REPRODUCTION.prompt:
You are reviewing whether the reproduction step correctly captured the reported bug.

INPUTS:
  context.diagnosisBrief — the structured diagnosis from DIAGNOSE_BUG
  context.reproductionResult — the full result object from the reproduce sub-agent
  context.pendingBugBatch[0] — the original bug report metadata

STEP 1 — Parse the sub-agent output.
Search reproductionResult.stdoutTail for:
  - TEST_FAILED=<output> (automated test confirmed failing)
  - TEST_SKIPPED=<reason> (testless path confirmed by code inspection)
  - TEST_FILE=<path> (which file holds the test)
  - TEST_COMMAND=<command>
  If reproductionResult.exitCode !== 0 OR reproductionResult.timedOut === true: treat as MISMATCH (sub-agent failed).

STEP 2 — Evaluate.

CASE A — TEST_FAILED present:
  Ask yourself: does this test failure correspond to the symptom the user reported?
  The test must exercise the trigger described in diagnosisBrief.reproductionSteps, not just any failure in the vicinity.
  If YES → verdict: 'pass'
  If NO → verdict: 'mismatch', reason: '<what the test exercises vs what the bug report describes>'

CASE B — TEST_SKIPPED present:
  Ask yourself: is the code inspection evidence cited in TEST_SKIPPED sufficient to confirm the root cause without a test?
  If YES → verdict: 'testless-confirmed'
  If NO → verdict: 'mismatch', reason: '<what additional evidence would be needed>'

CASE C — Neither present, or sub-agent failed/timed out:
  verdict: 'mismatch', reason: 'sub-agent did not emit TEST_FAILED or TEST_SKIPPED'

STEP 3 — Check retry budget.
  context.reproductionAttempts (default 0). If verdict === 'mismatch' AND reproductionAttempts >= 2:
    Override verdict to 'deferred', reason: 'exceeded 2 reproduction attempts — needs manual investigation'

STEP 4 — Set contextUpdates:
  contextUpdates.reproductionVerdict = { verdict, reason (if mismatch/deferred), testFile, testCommand, testOutput }
  If verdict === 'mismatch': contextUpdates.reproductionAttempts = (context.reproductionAttempts ?? 0) + 1
  If verdict === 'deferred': append { ...pendingBugBatch[0], outcome: 'deferred', reason } to contextUpdates.bugsFixed, set contextUpdates.currentBug = null

Propose transition:
  pass or testless-confirmed → IMPLEMENT_FIX
  mismatch (attempts < 2) → DIAGNOSE_BUG (re-diagnose with the mismatch reason as additional context — set contextUpdates.diagnosisMismatchReason = reason)
  deferred → WORK_ROUTER

IMPLEMENT_FIX.description: TDD pipeline step 4: a sub-agent receives the diagnosis brief and failing test, implements the fix until the test passes, then pushes a PR. Returns to VERIFY_DISCOURSE_BATCH for adversarial review.
IMPLEMENT_FIX.prompt:
You are dispatching the implementation agent. The diagnosis and reproduction are verified — now fix the bug TDD-style.

INPUTS:
  context.diagnosisBrief — the verified root cause
  context.reproductionVerdict — includes testFile, testCommand, testOutput (or testless-confirmed)
  context.pendingBugBatch[0] — bug metadata
  Previous rejection reason (if any): context.pendingBugBatch[0].reviewerReason

Build ONE task with id 'fix-<topic>-<post>':

Task: 'Fix the following verified bug using TDD. Do NOT re-diagnose — the root cause is confirmed.

  DIAGNOSIS BRIEF:
  Symptom: <diagnosisBrief.symptom>
  Root cause: <diagnosisBrief.rootCause>
  Evidence: <diagnosisBrief.evidence joined by newline>

  <IF testless-confirmed>
  This bug has no automated test (testless). Fix the root cause as described. After fixing, manually verify by reading the changed code and confirming the fix addresses the root cause. Emit: FIX_VERIFIED=testless — describe how the code change addresses the root cause.
  </IF>

  <IF test present>
  FAILING TEST:
    File: <reproductionVerdict.testFile>
    Command: <reproductionVerdict.testCommand>
    Failure output (confirm this still fails before you touch the implementation):
    <reproductionVerdict.testOutput>

  TASK:
  1. Run the test. Confirm it still fails. Emit: CONFIRMED_FAILING=yes
  2. Fix the production code (NOT the test) to make the root cause go away.
  3. Run the test again. It must pass. Emit: TEST_PASSED=<last 20 lines of output>
  4. Run the full test suite for this layer to check for regressions:
       go-api: cd /home/edward/FreegleDockerWSL/iznik-server-go && go test ./...
       nuxt: cd /home/edward/FreegleDockerWSL/iznik-nuxt3 && npm run test
       php: POST http://localhost:8081/api/tests/laravel {}
     Emit: SUITE_PASSED=yes (or SUITE_FAILED=<summary of failures>)
  5. If SUITE_FAILED: fix the regressions before pushing. Do not push with a red suite.
  </IF>

  BRANCH AND PR:
  - Branch: fix/<featureArea-slug>-<topic>-<post> (e.g. fix/stdmsg-delete-9518-217)
  - Commit message: fix(<featureArea>): <one-line description of the root cause fix>
  - Open a PR against master. PR body must include:
      ## Root cause
      <rootCause from diagnosisBrief>
      ## Fix
      <what the implementation changed and why>
      ## Test
      <testFile and testCommand, or "testless — see evidence" if applicable>
  - Emit: COMMIT_PUSHED=<sha>
  - Emit: PR_NUMBER=<n>'

Call delegate_parallel_tasks with this single task.
After it returns:
  Set contextUpdates.bugBatchResults = { results: [<the result>] }
  Keep contextUpdates.pendingBugBatch as-is (VERIFY_DISCOURSE_BATCH reads it).
Propose transition to VERIFY_DISCOURSE_BATCH.

VERIFY_DISCOURSE_BATCH.description: TDD pipeline step 5: adversarial review of the implemented fix. Receives the PR number from IMPLEMENT_FIX and the reproduction verdict from context. Calls adversarial_review_pr, records bugsFixed. Discourse reply drafts are NOT queued here — queued automatically by queue_deployed_reply_drafts during LOAD_STATE once deployed.
VERIFY_DISCOURSE_BATCH.prompt:
context.bugBatchResults.results[] contains one entry — the result from IMPLEMENT_FIX's delegate. context.pendingBugBatch[] has the bug metadata. context.reproductionVerdict has the test proof.

Process the single result:
  - bug = context.pendingBugBatch[0]
  - D = context.bugBatchResults.results[0]
  - verdict = context.reproductionVerdict

  SUCCESS: D.exitCode === 0 AND D.prNumber is a number AND D.timedOut !== true:
    (A) Call create_pr with { prNumber: D.prNumber, topic: bug.topic, post: bug.post, reporter: bug.user ?? bug.reporter, excerpt: bug.excerpt ?? bug.summary }. Passing topic+post is MANDATORY so the bug is immediately marked fix-queued in the DB — omitting them causes the next iteration to re-dispatch the same bug.
    (B) Call adversarial_review_pr with { prNumber: D.prNumber, repo: 'Freegle/Iznik' }.
        The adversarial reviewer must additionally check:
        - If verdict.verdict === 'pass': does the PR diff touch the code path identified in diagnosisBrief.evidence? Does it plausibly make the failing test pass?
        - If verdict.verdict === 'testless-confirmed': is there clear code evidence the root cause is fixed, even without a test?
        - SUITE_FAILED in the implementation output is a blocker — do not pass a PR with known regressions.
    (C) If review passed: do NOT call post_discourse_reply_draft here. The reply draft is automatically queued by queue_deployed_reply_drafts during LOAD_STATE once the fix is confirmed deployed to the production branch. Append { ...bug, prNumber: D.prNumber, frontendOnly: create_pr result.frontendOnly, outcome: 'fixed' } to contextUpdates.bugsFixed.
    (D) If review failed (blockers): Append { ...bug, outcome: 'deferred', reason: 'adversarial review blocked: ' + review.summary.slice(0,80) } to contextUpdates.bugsFixed.

  FAILURE: D.exitCode !== 0 OR D.prNumber missing OR D.timedOut === true:
    Do NOT call create_pr.
    Append { ...bug, outcome: 'deferred', reason: D.timedOut ? 'delegate timed out — re-run next iteration' : (D.failedReason ?? 'delegate failed') } to contextUpdates.bugsFixed.

After processing, set contextUpdates.currentBug = null. Reset contextUpdates.diagnosisBrief = null, contextUpdates.reproductionVerdict = null, contextUpdates.reproductionAttempts = 0.
Propose transition to WORK_ROUTER.

FIX_SENTRY_ISSUE.description: Fix one Sentry issue. Feature branch + PR.
FIX_SENTRY_ISSUE.prompt: Pick one actionable Sentry issue from context.sentryIssues. (1) Call read_sentry_issues for the detail. (2) Call search_code to locate the code. (3) Call delegate_to_coder with a task to diagnose, fix, push branch, open PR. (4) Call create_pr to verify. (5) Set contextUpdates.sentryFixAttempted = true. Propose transition to WORK_ROUTER.

REBASE_DIRTY_PRS.description: Rebase all @me open PRs with mergeStateStatus=DIRTY onto master. One delegate per dirty PR in parallel. Returns to COVERAGE_GATE so CI can re-verify after the force-push.
REBASE_DIRTY_PRS.prompt: context._action_coverage_gate_decide.dirtyPRs[] lists PRs that need a rebase. For each, build a task: 'Rebase PR #<n> (branch <branch>) onto master. Steps: (1) git -C /home/edward/FreegleDockerWSL checkout <branch> && git fetch origin master && git rebase origin/master. If rebase succeeds: git push --force-with-lease origin HEAD. If conflicts arise: git rebase --abort, then diagnose and resolve manually before pushing. Emit COMMIT_PUSHED=<sha> when done.' Use id: 'rebase-<n>' for each. Call delegate_parallel_tasks with all rebase tasks. After it returns, propose transition to COVERAGE_GATE.

COVERAGE_GATE.description: Structural gate: has this iteration produced a PR yet, and does any @me open PR currently have red CI or need rebase? Tool node — deterministic branching, no LLM turn. The single readAction coverage_gate_decide returns _transition: CI_ROUTER | REBASE_DIRTY_PRS | WRAP_UP | WRITE_COVERAGE.

WRITE_COVERAGE.description: Mandatory coverage PR. Single purpose: produce one coverage PR.
WRITE_COVERAGE.prompt:
No bug-fix PR was created this iteration. You MUST pick the next coverage target by strict rotation: Go → Vitest → Laravel → Go → …

STEP 1. Check what was last covered:
  sqlite3 /home/edward/FreegleDockerWSL/monitor-fsm/monitor.db "SELECT value FROM kv WHERE key='last_coverage_target'"
  Rotation order: Go → Vitest → Laravel → Go. If last was 'Go', pick 'Vitest'. If last was 'Vitest', pick 'Laravel'. If last was 'Laravel' or blank, pick 'Go'.

STEP 2. Record the choice BEFORE delegating:
  sqlite3 /home/edward/FreegleDockerWSL/monitor-fsm/monitor.db "INSERT INTO kv(key,value) VALUES('last_coverage_target','<chosen>') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value"

STEP 3. Call delegate_to_coder with a task to write TDD tests for the chosen suite, commit, push a feature branch, and open a PR. Suite-specific guidance:
  - Go: pure unit tests in iznik-server-go/, no Docker/DB required, run `go test ./...` to verify.
  - Vitest: component or composable tests in iznik-nuxt3/, run `npm run test` in iznik-nuxt3/ to verify.
  - Laravel: feature or unit tests in iznik-batch/, run `php artisan test` inside the batch container to verify.

STEP 4. When delegate returns with a prNumber: (1) Call adversarial_review_pr. (2) If passed, call create_pr and propose transition to COVERAGE_GATE. (3) If failed with blockers, set contextUpdates.coveragePRReviewFailed = { prNumber, issues } and propose transition to COVERAGE_GATE anyway.

WRAP_UP.description: Write the iteration summary to /tmp/freegle-monitor/summary.md. Tool node — summary is composed from context + DB, no LLM turn.

SCHEDULE_NEXT.description: Schedule next wakeup. Tool node — delay chosen by rule (≤270s if watching PR CI, else 1500s idle).

transitions.label: drain mode — CI pending on open PRs
master green — dispatch PRs + topics + sentry in parallel
dirty PRs need rebase — fix before coverage
open PR red — must fix first (fall back to phase A)
